known_formula.source_budget: identity source coordinates verified; repeated expanded slot ASTs count separately

generation: Pinned native E2E receives exact reduced Train observations and unchanged X; no unknown-slot pseudo-label heuristic
template_stage: known outer formula determines observations before generation; exact original outer AST is assembled afterwards
response_stage: original-y finite-point coefficient constraints on every returned native slot candidate; not decoder conditioning
fidelity: native parity belongs to archived slot candidates; assembled strict-real variants use common evaluator consistency only
numerical_scope: MSE proportionality is algebraic, not invariant pretrained proposals, BFGS tolerances, convergence or performance

native_best_tracking.implementation: pinned TimedFun finite-best correction; independent worker scope
native_best_tracking.scope: best objective value actually observed, not solver convergence; NoRef retained

operator_mask.scope: native operator tokens only; not arity, numeric syntax, variable, EOS, node count or semantic constraints
operator_mask.distribution: operator-restricted pretrained next-token distribution; weights unchanged
operator_mask.portable_scope: fixed normalization retained; full output grammar/size checked separately without exemption
operator_mask.score_semantics: beam scores retain raw pretrained log-probability; prefix grammar/variable/size masks restrict sampling; operator restriction follows enabled flag; adapter does not export sampling log-probabilities

native_summary.runtime_patch: PyTorch2 EOS boolean mask; corrected finite best-value tracking; bounded bag batches alter sampling RNG ordering; BFGS uses full Train instead of prefix1024; scalar grammar and source AST budget restrict generation; pretrained weights unchanged
native_summary.model_license: no separate weights license confirmed; official download only
native_summary.refinement_failures: Upstream suppresses individual BFGS failure reasons; zero BFGS outputs is not refinement success. Native NoRef candidates are retained independently.

variable_mask.scope: decoder variable tokens only; full original input columns remain encoder context; no unit/response/template guarantee

complexity_budget.scope: generation grammar and source AST size; not physical dimensions or response constraints

native_summary.budget_semantics: beam_size is native samples per bag plus greedy, not beam search width; all bags generated and all Train rows used for refinement; refinement_seconds is native per-tree refinement limit
native_summary.generation: seeded native sampling plus greedy candidate; pretrained weights unchanged; batch-size changes can change RNG consumption and candidates
native_summary.transforms: train-only StandardScaler; fixed original-coordinate mean/scale; no target scaling
native_summary.coefficient_policy: native decimal slots free; integer/operator literals and normalization fixed

constraint_support.operators: operator_mask defaults true and restricts decoder operator tokens; explicit false is post-check-only compatibility; portable full expression including normalization still post-filtered
constraint_support.units: native unit guidance unsupported; train normalization units preserved, coefficient units unknown
constraint_support.max_nodes: native prefix completion budget includes frozen source coordinates and fixed E2E normalization; export verification retained
constraint_support.variables: 1..10 unchanged input columns; output variable-token masking
constraint_support.allowed_variables: enforced in native decoder variable tokens; original columns/IDs retained; padded tokens forbidden
constraint_support.rows: default resource guard 1024 rows; explicit max_train_rows=null uses all bags under outer wall/memory limits; no subsampling
constraint_support.probes: explicit finite-point constraints during SLSQP coefficient search over every exported structure; decoder not response-conditioned
constraint_support.response_bounds: finite-point hard bounds during coefficient optimization; no global guarantee
constraint_support.response_checks: finite-step conditions during coefficient optimization; not decoder conditioning or analytic derivative proof
constraint_support.pretraining_overlap: unknown; pretrained weights inference only, no fine-tuning
constraint_support.equation_template: limited exact affine observed slot h(X); numeric target reduction before native generation, original outer-AST assembly and coefficient fit afterwards; no template-conditioned decoder
